steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and milk in the mixer.
Knead until smooth, then chill the dough in the fridge.
Laminate with butter using the mixer and rolling techniques.
Roll out dough and cut into triangles.
Place red bean or custard filling at the wide end.
Roll tightly and press into the fish-shaped moulds.
Proof the shaped dough until puffy.
Brush with egg wash for a golden finish.
Bake in the oven until crisp and golden brown.

hooks: Flaky layers inside a fish shape.
